competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease the Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: After you attack, recovers your HP by 10% per enemy granted with a harmful effect among the targets you attacked. In addition, when an enemy granted with a harmful effect gains a turn, increases your Attack Bar by 10%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: After you attack, per enemy granted with a harmful effect.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: When an enemy granted with a harmful effect gains a turn

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 3 times. Each hit removes 1 beneficial effect and grants Suppression for 1 turn.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The HP is reduced by 50% of the MAX HP if the target uses a skill with cooldown time, and the MAX cooldown time of the used skill is increased by 3 turns.
